meta.name: influencer-prospecting
meta.description: Use when the user wants to find creators, influencers, affiliates, or social accounts in a niche for outreach, partnerships, sponsorships, UGC, seeding, or competitive research. Produces scored prospect lists from public social data.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按领域筛选出值得合作的影响者名单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想找特定领域的影响者做推广或合作
copy.tagline_en: Find influencers worth partnering with in any niche
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to find influencers in a niche for partnerships or promotion

howto.what: 当你需要找某个领域的网红、创作者、联盟伙伴或社交账号时，Claude 会搜索 TikTok、Instagram、YouTube 等公开社交数据，按利基匹配、受众、影响力、互动、品牌安全、可联系性逐项打 1-5 分，最后输出候选清单、最佳匹配、外联角度和 CSV 文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求找某一利基的创作者/网红、构建 UGC/联盟/赞助/寄样清单，或导出 CSV 候选时触发。

say.text: 帮我找 20 个 TikTok 上做健身的创作者
say.note: 会生成带评分和联系方式的候选清单

say.text: 找 10 个在 Instagram 上谈护肤品的微网红
say.note: 按利基匹配和互动质量打分

say.text: 把这批候选导出成 CSV 表格
say.note: 输出可直接下载的 CSV 文件

howto.what_en: Claude finds niche creators from public social data, scores them 1-5 on fit, audience, reach, engagement, safety, contactability, and outputs a scored prospect list plus CSV.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to find influencers/creators in a niche, build a UGC/affiliate/sponsorship/seeding list, or export prospects as CSV.

say_en.note: Generates a scored prospect list with contacts

say_en.text: Find 10 micro-influencers on Instagram talking about skincare
say_en.note: Scores by niche fit and engagement

say_en.text: Export these prospects as a CSV file
